action_description: A 16-frame in-place walk cycle. Keep frame 1 unchanged; frames 2-8 make the first step, frame 9 the opposite contact, and frames 10-16 make the second step and return.
locked_constraints: animate in place with no horizontal travel
keep contact feet on the common ground line
preserve outfit, equipment, proportions, and palette
keep the full character inside the canvas
loop_constraint: The last frame must flow into frame 1 with matching body height and momentum.
